tools.name: getSiteOverview
tools.description: Get an overview of VibeAudit (https://audit.al157.xyz), a one-shot website security-audit service for AI-generated ("vibe-coded") apps. Returns the service list (secret leak detection, vulnerability pattern scanning, human review), current pricing, the public contact email, and the booking CTA / sit

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "getSiteOverview" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get an overview of VibeAudit (https://audit.al157.xyz), a one-shot website security-audit service for AI-generated ("vibe-coded") apps. Returns the service list…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getSiteOverview · Private data: getSiteOverview · Public sink: getSiteOverview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getSiteOverview · Private data: getSiteOverview · Public sink: getSiteOverview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
